name: @corbits-builder/publish
description: Records where the project's app was last published, which every publish target writes, and asks the person where to publish, for their go-ahead to each publish they ask for, and before taking the app down. It publishes nothing itself: a ready-made plan in the publish group does, such as publish-to-server.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: The person asks to publish their app or the changes they made to it, or to take it down. The app is published through a ready-made plan in the publish group, one for each kind of place it can go: when more than one is installed the person chooses with choose. Each publish the person asks for needs their go-ahead from confirm once, which publish agreed then says stands until it went out; an attempt that fails or waits on another step goes on under it. Taking it down needs their go-ahead from take-down, opened with the plan whose place publish.release or publish.holding names; that plan's guidance says what follows.
builder.unless: The project has no saved app yet, or the person only asks where or whether it is published, which publish.release records.

publish.release.about: Where the project's app was last published, as { "target": the plugin that published it, such as server, "url": the address people open it at, "version": the saved app's version that went out, "at": when, as an ISO time, and "replaceable": false when the next publish there makes a new address rather than updating it }; null once it was taken down or is gone, and none while it was never published.

publish.plan.about: The handle of the ready-made publish plan the person chose to publish the app by, such as publish-to-server; none while they never chose, as when only one is installed.

publish.go-ahead.about: The person's go-ahead to publish, from publish confirm, as { "plan": the handle of the ready-made plan it is for, "at": when they gave it, as an ISO time }; null once they agreed to take the app down, and none while they never gave one. It stands until a release is recorded after it, as publish agreed says. Only the publish plugin's screens set it.

publish.keep.about: The link the person opens to keep an app that was published without an account at its host, until when, and where it was published, as { "link": the link, "until": an ISO time, "place": the plain name of the host, such as Cloudflare }; none while there is nothing to keep. Only a target's own tool sets it, and the person clears it from the Publish tab once they kept the app or it is gone.

publish.holding.about: Something that costs money that a publish target made for the project, such as a server it rented, as { "target": the plugin that made it, such as digitalocean, "place": the plain name of where it is, "since": when it was made, as an ISO time, and "costs": what it costs, as the person reads it, such as $6 a month }; none while nothing is held. Only that target's own tools set it, and clear it once the thing is gone; the person may also clear it from the Publish tab once they removed it themselves.

publish.take-down.about: The person's go-ahead to take down what a publish target published or holds, as { "target": the plugin that published or holds it, "release": the at of the release they were shown, "holding": the since of the holding they were shown, each as an ISO time and left out when there was none }; null when they chose to keep it or gave their go-ahead to publish again. Only the publish plugin's screens set it.

facts.agreed:publish: the person's go-ahead to publish by the chosen plan stands: they gave it on publish confirm and the publish it allows has not gone out yet
